attrs.label: TrueNAS Web Interface HTTPS Port
attrs.description: The HTTPS port of the TrueNAS web interface (System > General Settings > GUI).

attrs.label: TrueNAS API Key
attrs.description:
API key used to read datasets and snapshots. The app only performs read-only queries
unless "Allow Deleting Snapshots" is enabled.</br>
Recommended: create a dedicated user in a group with the Read-Only Administrator privilege
(Credentials > Users / Groups), then create an API key for it (user menu > My API Keys).

attrs.label: Cache Duration (minutes)
attrs.description: How long snapshot data is cached before it is fetched again. The Refresh button always fetches fresh data.

attrs.label: Allow Import of zfs list Output
attrs.description: Allow uploading the output of `zfs list` in the web UI to visualise snapshots of other systems. Uploaded data is never stored.

attrs.label: Use HTTPS
attrs.description:
Serve the web UI over HTTPS with an automatically generated self-signed certificate.</br>
Your browser shows a certificate warning once (like for the TrueNAS web interface).

attrs.label: Web UI Password
attrs.description:
Password required to open the web UI. Leave empty to allow access without login.</br>
Strongly recommended when deleting snapshots is allowed.

attrs.label: Allow Deleting Snapshots
attrs.description:
When enabled, deleting snapshots can be switched on in the web UI settings (per browser)
and every deletion needs a double confirmation. Disable to lock deleting completely.</br>
Snapshots managed by TrueNAS (boot environments, system and app datasets) can never be deleted.</br>
Without a Web UI Password anyone who can reach the web UI can switch deleting on.</br>
The API key's user needs the SNAPSHOT_DELETE role (e.g. Full Admin); Read-Only Administrator can only view.

attrs.label: Port Bind Mode
attrs.description:
The port bind mode.</br>
- Publish: The port will be published on the host for external access.</br>
- Expose: The port will be exposed for inter-container communication.</br>
- None: The port will not be exposed or published.</br>
Note: If the Dockerfile defines an EXPOSE directive,
the port will still be exposed for inter-container communication regardless of this setting.

1.0.1.readme:
Snapshot Visualizer

Snapshot Visualizer shows the ZFS snapshots of your TrueNAS system the way WinDirStat shows files: a cushion treemap by size, a timeline by age, per-dataset statistics and a sortable snapshot table, so you can quickly see which snapshots and periodic tasks use your space.

⚠️ WARNING: This app requires a TrueNAS API key, which gives it administrative control over the system.

Misconfiguration or a malicious update can compromise data integrity, security, or system stability. Install at your own risk.
